cases.description: When the input byte array is null, encodeBase64Chunked should return null.
When the input byte array is empty, encodeBase64Chunked should return an empty byte array.
Encode a single non‑zero byte; result should be the Base64 string "AQ==" without any line separators.
Encode a single zero byte; result should be "AA==" without any line separators.

group: Chunked Encoding without Line Break (exact 76 chars)

cases.description: Encode 57 zero bytes. 57 bytes → 76 Base64 characters (no padding). Because the output length is exactly 76, no CRLF line separator should be added.

group: Chunked Encoding with One Line Break

cases.description: Encode 58 zero bytes. 58 bytes → 78 Base64 characters, which exceeds the 76‑character line limit. The method should insert a CRLF after the first 76 characters, then output the remaining "AA==".

group: Chunked Encoding with Multiple Line Breaks

input: description": "Encode 58 zero bytes; output should contain one CRLF after the first 76 characters, followed by the remaining "AA==".
